ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels covering approximately 88% of the surface, with localized high-intensity (white) pixel clusters primarily at the distal right tip and scattered circular points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity contiguous geometric blob at the distal right lobe tip; discrete high-intensity circular points distributed across the medial and lateral surfaces of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 60 degrees and a depth roughly 15% of the total vertical height of the visible lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular peaks and valleys along the entire trailing edge; amplitudes are highest on the medial margins adjacent to the notch and on the outer distal sections.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating from the notch, transitioning to a sharp convex sweep at the outer distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of at least 14 distinct circular high-contrast ring-like clusters, varying in diameter from 5 to 15 pixels, concentrated in the central and right medial regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of 5 parallel vertical high-contrast linear marks on the distal left lobe; several unaligned horizontal linear disruptions visible in the lower central fluke region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep vertical rake marks on the left distal lobe; extensive distribution of circular barnacle attachment scars across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Densely packed white pixel cluster creating a localized 'speckled' appearance at the extreme distal tip of the right lobe.
